name: alterlab-citation-verifier
description: Verifies that every bibliography entry actually exists by cross-checking Crossref, OpenAlex, Semantic Scholar, and arXiv (no API key required) plus doi.org DOI registration, fuzzy-matching title and authors (difflib ratio >= 0.70), flagging retractions recorded by Crossref (including Retraction Watch data) or OpenAlex, and emitting per-entry JSON verdicts in the AlterLab citation-hallucination taxonomy (TF/PAC/IH/PH/SH); a companion script scores whether a cited abstract supports a claim (SH). A
author: AlterLab-IEU
